description:
What you'll do
Own the design and implementation of functional blocks within the accelerator pipeline
Write and debug RTL (Verilog/SystemVerilog) for your assigned block
Collaborate with verification engineers to define test plans and close coverage
Analyze performance, timing, and area tradeoffs and propose improvements
Participate in design reviews and document your block's architecture and behavior
What we're looking for
BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
Recently completed coursework in computer microarchitecture, covering at least one of: 
Cache/memory systems
Computer arithmetic
Pipeline design
Working knowledge of a modern ISA
Familiarity with parallel accelerator architectures, such as: 
SIMD / SIMT / vector processing
Out-of-order scheduling
Hands-on Verilog/SystemVerilog experience, including: 
Simulation and testbench debugging
Timing and power closure
Understanding of the end-to-end ASIC design flow and general VLSI concepts
Scripting experience (Python, Perl, or Tcl); C/C++ a plus
